left.raw_text: Other causes of heart failure other than diastolic dysfunction, such as restrictive cardiomyopathy or infiltrative cardiomyopathy
Women who are pregnant or nursing

OR.raw_text: Causes of PH other than that of heart failure, such as: chronic thromboembolic PH, sickle-cell disease, or sarcoidosis,
Severe bradycardia or greater than 1st degree heart block,
Current use of a third generation beta-blocker (nebivolol, carvedilol, or labetalol) or high dose of any beta-blockers (greater than 100 mg daily of metoprolol, or equivalent).
